title: Gathering Thyme | Real Joy
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book Gathering Thyme:* Walk to Beachwood Villas Beach Access* Multiple Outdoor Spaces* Gorgeous Interior* 4 Bikes Included* Community Pool* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Café 30A, Old Florida
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book Gathering Thyme:* Walk to Beachwood Villas Beach Access* Multiple Outdoor Spaces* Gorgeous Interior* 4 Bikes Included* Community Pool* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Café 30A, Old Florida Fish House, and The Big Chill nearby * Only 3.5 miles to Seaside and 5 miles to Rosemary Beach * Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service *This property is not available to adults Under the age of 25. No Exceptions. * Welcome to Gathering Thyme, a delightful 4-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom home in the charming village of Sugar Beach, just a short stroll from the Gulf! Designed with entertaining in mind, this stunning home features a screened porch, a gas grill in the backyard, and inviting front porches and balconies to enjoy the sea breeze. You'll also have access to a shared sparkling pool for extra relaxation. Culinary enthusiasts will love the fully equipped kitchen, complete with gleaming granite countertops, a large island, and Bosch stainless steel appliances. Enjoy meals at the elegant dining table for six, on the four-person island, or al fresco at the outdoor dining table for six, complemented by a patio set for four. This spacious two-story home accommodates up to 11 guests, with a exquisite king master bedroom and en-suite bathroom on the first floor. The second floor features another king master bedroom with an en-suite, a guest bedroom with a king bed, and a second guest room with one queen bed and a twin-over-full bunk bed, perfect for families. After a fun-filled day, take a leisurely stroll to the beach and witness breathtaking sunsets. Come create unforgettable memories that will last a lifetime at Gathering Thyme!Sugar Beach is a South Walton neighborhood that resembles a tropical paradise, featuring lush landscaping throughout the community. All homes are just a short walk from a beautiful lagoon-shaped pool. The pool area is accessed through a gated, covered pergola, offering an elegant entrance with restroom facilities and showers for convenience. The sun-soaked pool patio is surrounded by tropical palm trees, providing a relaxing atmosphere for lounging. In addition to the community pool, the stunning crystalline white beach is just a short distance away. A public access point on Scenic 30A leads you to the shimmering shoreline and the emerald-toned waters of the Gulf, offering a perfect coastal retreat.The Bed Setup: First Floor Master Bedroom 1: King Bed Second Floor Master Bedroom 2: King Bed Guest Bedroom 1: King Bed Guest Bedroom 2: One queen bed and One Twin-over-Full Bunkbed (sleeps 5)AREA ATTRACTIONS: “The Big Chill” is the community center for Prominence and is a quick 10-minute bike ride from your home or a 1.6-mile drive. The Big Chill offers something for folks of all ages and tastes, from tacos and tequila to wings, burgers, and shakes, a stop here is quick, tasty, and convenient, and comes with a side of entertainment at the outdoor amphitheater. It's a great place to catch a concert, sporting event, or a movie on the lawn. Seaside is a short drive away and is most widely known for being featured in The Truman Show with Jim Carrey. It's incredible architecture has helped to make it famous and it's a faithful replication of the kind of seaside town that used to be common up and down the coast. Seaside has a Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater, and neighborhood school. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes Seaside famous. There are activities for everyone: kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here.The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
